def getClosestMatch(path, mapping):
		parts = path.split('\\')
		
		for i in range(len(parts), 0, -1):
			candidate = '\\'.join(parts[:i])
			if candidate in mapping: return mapping[candidate]
		
		return None  # or a default value

	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
	paramsDict = {'enabled': True, 'userId': userId}
	value = dict(value)
	
	if value is None or len(value) == 0: value = {"assetId": None, "expand": True, "level": 0}
	if value['assetId']: paramsDict['assetPath'] = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue("assetPath", system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetId': value['assetId']})) +'%'
	
#	system.perspective.print("Getting assets...")

	assetAttributes = system.kanoa.asset.getAssetAttributes({'assetAttrName': '_showOnMainDisplay'})
	assetDisplayOptions = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(assetAttributes, 'assetPath', 'assetAttrValue')
	
#	system.perspective.print("Getting OEEStateDisplay attributes....")
	assetAttributes = system.kanoa.asset.getAssetAttributes({'assetAttrName': '_assetOEEStateDisplay'})
	assetOEEStateDisplayOptions = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(assetAttributes, 'assetPath', 'assetAttrValue')
		
	hierarchy = {}	
	
	for asset in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(assets):
#		system.perspective.print("Building %s"%asset['assetName'])
		isEnabled = asset['oeeEnabled']
		isLine = asset['assetTypeName'].lower() == 'line'
		isVisible = bool(int(assetDisplayOptions.get(asset['assetPath'], 0)))
		if not isEnabled or (not isLine and not isVisible): continue

#		assetOEEStateDisplay = assetOEEStateDisplayOptions[asset['assetPath']] if assetOEEStateDisplayOptions.has_key(asset['assetPath']) else 'kanoa/mes/asset/overview/assetStates/assetOEEStateDefault'

		asset['_assetOEEStateDisplay'] = getClosestMatch(asset['assetPath'], assetOEEStateDisplayOptions)

		path = asset['assetPath'].split('\\')
		branch = hierarchy
		count = len(path)
		lastIndex = count-1
		
		for i in range(count):
			name = path[i]
			nPath = '\\'.join(path[0:i + 1])
			if not assetDict.has_key(nPath): continue
			if i == lastIndex: 	branch[name] = {'assetInfo': asset}
			else:
				if not name in branch: 	branch[name] = {'assetInfo': assetDict[nPath]}
				branch = branch[name]
	
	system.perspective.print("Completed mainView assetTree")	
	
	return hierarchy
